ArtifactRef.description: Public immutable object-version identity; neither location nor access authority.
ArtifactRef.title: ArtifactRef

CursorLookup.description: Partial authoritative lookup states remain representable for fail-closed recovery.
CursorLookup.title: CursorLookup

EventCursor.description: Private authenticated lookup result; possession does not authorize any read.
EventCursor.title: EventCursor

EventDelivery.description: SSE id is resume_cursor; data is this exact canonical message, not just the event.
EventDelivery.title: EventDelivery

ExperimentRecordBinding.description: Private record/readback join, not a public response or a live read authorization.
ExperimentRecordBinding.title: ExperimentRecordBinding

ExperimentRecordRef.description: Public exact object and typed SCI identity; neither URL nor read permission.
ExperimentRecordRef.title: ExperimentRecordRef

HistoryManifest.description: Immutable root; full verification requires all hash-linked pages and actual chunks.
HistoryManifest.title: HistoryManifest

HistoryPage.description: Immutable bounded linked page; the root pins the first page, each page pins the next.
HistoryPage.title: HistoryPage

HistoryPageBinding.description: One bounded manifest/page/predecessor join; it cannot certify missing earlier pages.
HistoryPageBinding.title: HistoryPageBinding

ObjectVerification.description:
Trusted complete stored-byte readback, not object user metadata or a client claim.

The producer verifies the entire raw byte stream at this exact generation,
with transport checksum validation where supported. This message does not do I/O.
ObjectVerification.title: ObjectVerification

ReplayChunkBinding.description: Intrinsic supplied join; producers still verify actual raw bytes before typed parsing.
ReplayChunkBinding.title: ReplayChunkBinding

RunArtifactRecord.description: Current tenant/run catalog row; producer establishes currency and namespace ownership.
RunArtifactRecord.title: RunArtifactRecord

SnapshotRecord.description: Trusted captured closure; later live run/head may advance without changing this record.
SnapshotRecord.title: SnapshotRecord

StorageLocator.description: Private configured namespace and server-assigned key; no client URL or credentials.
StorageLocator.title: StorageLocator

StreamHead.description: One trusted current snapshot; sequence never resets at lease or retention boundaries.
StreamHead.title: StreamHead

WebPolicy.description: Required trusted deployment bounds; smaller limits may reject, never truncate.
WebPolicy.title: WebPolicy
